description:
Durable Book Shipping Boxes Built to Protect

Book Shipping Boxes, also known as wrap style shippers, are designed to protect heavy, flat items like books, catalogs, manuals, and other printed materials. The one-piece folder construction wraps tightly around your product for a snug fit, while the reinforced bottom adds extra strength during transit. Made from sturdy corrugated cardboard, these shippers help prevent bending, corner damage, and shifting, so the contents arrive in excellent condition.

Make Every Shipment On-Brand 

Start by choosing the right size. Select from six standard dimensions designed for popular book formats or create a custom size for a precise fit. Because these boxes wrap closely around your product, accurate interior measurements help reduce movement and improve protection during shipping. 

Next, customize the look and feel of your box. Choose from white, premium white, or kraft corrugated materials, then select the right finish to match your brand aesthetic. You can print on the outside, inside, both sides, or keep it blank, giving you full control over how your books are presented from delivery to unboxing.
